difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-coherent F on a locally Noetherian scheme X with Ass(F) contained in an open U, the restriction map Gamma(X, F) -> Gamma(U, F) is injective (source lines 198-204). The proof follows the weakly associated companion with Ass in place of WeakAss: it forms the image F' of the section map, notes Supp(F') misses U, uses that Ass(F') is contained in Ass(F) and in Supp(F') so that Ass(F') is empty, and applies the vanishing lemma for modules with no associated points.
